subject: BrightCart discovery follow-up — model selection, eval artifacts, and A/B plan
messages:
From: Rita Chen <rita.chen@brightcart.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightCart discovery — rerank evaluation & next steps

Connor / Marissa,

Thanks again for the call earlier — useful conversation. A quick recap and a couple of asks from our side so we can prioritize the proof-of-value: 

- Goal: improve search relevance for product listings (homepage + category search) using a rerank step. Primary metrics: NDCG@10 and MRR, especially for long-tail queries.
- Constraints: 95th percentile latency target < 150ms (p99 for interactive pages), cost target ~25% below our current managed endpoint spend.
- Data: we can provide a 3k-query labeled set (judgments.csv) and a 50k anonymized query log for offline ranking.

Requests:
1) Can you recommend 2 model families (one smaller / cheaper, one higher-accuracy) we should start with for reranking?
2) Can you run an initial offline eval (NDCG@10, MRR) on our 3k judged set and share the fold-level results and artifacts?
3) Please outline a minimal A/B/canary plan that won't disrupt production but lets us validate relevance + latency.

If you need more context on our prompt templates or the exact label schema I can attach them — attaching a quick sample record in a follow-up.

Appreciate it,
Rita

--
Rita Chen
Head of Search, BrightCart
rita.chen@brightcart.com

---

From: Connor Obrien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Rita Chen <rita.chen@brightcart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightCart discovery — model selection, eval artifacts, and A/B plan (post-call)

Thanks Rita — great summary. Below is what we propose for next steps, a quick model shortlist, and the artifacts we'll deliver for the offline eval.

TL;DR (recommendations)
- Budget model (fast / low-cost): distilled Llama-2-13B-q4 (quantized, batched rerank) — target for lower cost per token and sub-100ms kernel paths for short contexts.
- Accuracy model (higher-quality): Mistral-70B-instruct-quant (medium quantization) or rw-rerank-6b-v2 (a Redwood-tuned reranker) — expect +3–6% absolute NDCG lift vs. baseline in our benchmarks.

Planned offline eval artifacts (deliver by EOD Thursday 5/24):
- rerank_ndcg_mrr_summary.xlsx (per-fold NDCG@10, MRR, pairwise significance, latency percentiles)
- brightcart_promptset_v1.csv (prompt templates we used + mapping to judgment schema)
- ab_canary_playbook.md (step-by-step: traffic splits, monitoring hooks, rollback criteria, costing estimate)
- scripts and a small canonical Docker image to reproduce metrics (Drive link below).

Initial evaluation plan and assumptions:
- We will run 5-fold evaluation on your 3k judged set (stratified by query frequency).
- Baseline: your current production ranking scores (provided by you) + a simple BM25 baseline we compute.
- Models to evaluate: Llama-2-13B-q4, Mistral-7B-Instruct, rw-rerank-6b-v2, and a tuned cross-encoder LTR hybrid (small).
- Metrics: NDCG@1/5/10, MRR, p@1, and 95/99 latency measured on a representative batch sampler.

Quality-regression notes:
- We'll include per-query delta breakdowns so you can spot regressions on important SKU families.
- We recommend a small held-out prompt set with 120
